messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — we need to lock owners and timelines for the remediation backlog. Primary concerns: recurring cache-eviction spike, on-deploy rollout gaps, and missing SLO alert thresholds. Please volunteer owners and add JIRA links.

Jess: I can take initial triage for the cache-eviction pattern. Will create a ticket and add diagnostic logs.

Maria: I can own rollout/process updates (canary + runbook). Suggest target 2-week remediation window for process changes.

Raj: I can own alerting + metric work (tuning thresholds and dashboards). Need to pair with infra to confirm KV cache metrics.

Taylor: I'll handle the deployment gating checklist and the A/B rollback playbook. Happy to help with canary testing.

ops-bot: New JIRA created: RINF-3421 — "Investigate repeated cache-eviction spikes" assigned to Jess. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-3421

Jess: Created subtask RINF-3421-1 for root-cause logs collection. Tagging Raj for the metric correlation.

Raj: On it — will add a dashboard and provisional alert RINF-3422 (unassigned until we confirm thresholds).

Maria: I'll spin up a canary runbook PR and link it to RINF-3423. Can we make rollout checklist depend on RINF-3421 completion?

Sam: Yes — make RINF-3423 blocked-by RINF-3421. Priority: P1 for the cache work, P2 for rollout automation.

Taylor: For deployment gating, recommend these quick checks:
```
- verify KV cache hit-rate > 70%
- recent evictions < 5/min average
- canary latency within baseline +-10%
```
I'll add to RINF-3423.

Jess: Quick note: collected two example traces showing eviction pattern around 03:12 UTC. Pasted log snippet in the ticket.

Raj: For alert tuning, propose creating a composite alert: eviction-rate + sustained retry errors. Will draft thresholds and post here for review.

Sam: RACI proposal:
- Responsible (R): Jess (cache RCA)
- Accountable (A): Maria (rollout + process)
- Consulted (C): Raj, Taylor
- Informed (I): Eng-oncall + Product PMs
Add objections now if anyone disagrees.

Maria: Fine with that. I'll update the postmortem doc and add owners table.

Taylor: No objections. Timeline question: is 2 weeks ok for the full rollout automation?

Sam: 2 weeks for the runbook + canary plan, 4 weeks for automation and follow-up metrics. If RINF-3421 root cause is quick, we can accelerate.

Jess: I'll attach diagnostic query I used: `select eviction_count, timestamp from kv_stats where eviction_count > 0 order by timestamp desc limit 500` — putting it in RINF-3421.

Raj: ETA: dashboard + draft alerts by EOD Thursday. Will post the exact thresholds there.

ops-bot: Subtask created: RINF-3421-1 "collect traces & reproduce eviction locally" assigned to Jess.

Sam: Action items summary (manual):
- RINF-3421: Investigate cache-eviction — Owner: Jess (R) — Subtask RINF-3421-1 created.
- RINF-3422: Alerting + dashboard — Owner: Raj (C) — ETA Thu EOD.
- RINF-3423: Canary/runbook + rollout checklist — Owner: Maria (A) — target 2w for runbook, 4w for automation.
- Deployment gating & rollback playbook — Owner: Taylor (C).

Sam: Please update the JIRA tickets with PR links and mark me in the watchers. We'll meet 48 hours after RINF-3422 alert draft to approve thresholds.

Maria: I'll add a calendar invite for the 48h sync and create the owners table in the postmortem doc.

Jess: Starting work now, will post progress updates in the ticket and here. :thumbsup:

Raj: I'll post dashboard link once created.

Taylor: Will draft rollback playbook and attach to RINF-3423.

Sam: Thanks all — closing the thread for now. If anything changes, update here or ping me directly.
